note: Live score ticker — PREPARED AND OFF (v113). Nothing renders and no network call is made while `enabled` is false. To turn it on, set `feed` to the FULL url of something that serves the scoreboard shape — either the Sports-Hub endpoint (.../api/fantasy/football/scoreboard) or the Supabase route in front of it (.../functions/v1/league-parlay/api/parlay/scoreboard) — and set `enabled` to true. Prefer the Supabase one: it is what keeps a sleeping Render box out of twelve members' request path. See the v113 section of CLAUDE.md first.
